title: Sales By Customer link, PDF and CSV work as before the release
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure the organization has two or more locations, so one location can be ticked in Sales By Customer's Location filter.
  • Make sure that before the release was installed, you saved Sales By Customer's PDF and CSV for an as-of date before the release with one location ticked, and copied a link to Sales By Customer with that filter.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • After the release is installed, open Reports (top menu; its left menu lists the A/R reports under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE and the A/P reports under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Sales By Customer link saved before the release.
  2. Choose "Download (PDF)" from the ⋯ menu.
  3. Open the PDF and compare it with the saved PDF.
  4. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu.
  5. Open the CSV and compare it with the saved CSV.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales By Customer opens with the same filter ticked as before.

Step 2:

  • The PDF downloads.

Step 3:

  • The same rows, amounts and layout as the saved PDF.

Step 4:

  • The CSV downloads.

Step 5:

  • The same rows, amounts and layout as the saved CSV.

Why: the six aging reports reuse the filter chips, totals row and export of Inventory Value, Sales By Customer and Work In Progress, so a change made for the aging reports could reach those three.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location), story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • Key Decisions, reuse rule: “The reuse rule. Every control on these reports reuses an existing ShopView pattern: the native filter chips, the native totals row and pinned headline column of the newer reports, the existing location-switch prompt, the design system's chevron icon. Nothing new is drawn. Basis: d-reuse-existing-pattern.”

From: Developer verify task SV-11597 "A/R & A/P aging — verify Phase 1: shared report kit" (updated 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Jira SV-11597, Check: “Inventory Value, Sales By Customer and Work In Progress: filters, links shared from the address bar, and CSV/PDF exports behave exactly as before.”
